arguments.command:
pip install pyarrow -q && python3 - <<'PY'
import urllib.request, pyarrow.parquet as pq
url='https://huggingface.co/datasets/bigcode/bigcodebench/resolve/main/data/v0.1.4-00000-of-00001.parquet'
fn='/tmp/bcb.parquet'
urllib.request.urlretrieve(url, fn)
t=pq.read_table(fn)
print(t.num_rows)
import re
phrases=['configured user authentication','Flask-Login','task_func(secret_key, template_folder)']
for p in phrases:
    matches=[]
    for i,row in enumerate(t.to_pylist()):
        if p in (row.get('complete_prompt') or '') or p in (row.get('instruct_prompt') or '') or p in (row.get('canonical_solution') or ''):
            matches.append(row)
    print('PHRASE',p,'count',len(matches))
    for r in matches[:5]:
        print(r['task_id'])
        print('COMPLETE:',r['complete_prompt'][:1500])
        print('SOLUTION:',r['canonical_solution'][:3000])
        print('TEST:',r['test'][:2000])
        print('---')
PY
